parakeet: Continuing to advocate for prayer as a solution to critical problems is not only dishonest but also dangerous. It can lead individuals to neglect necessary medical treatments, relying instead on ineffective spiritual remedies. This neglect can result in preventable suffering or even death, particularly among those who lack the resources or knowledge or agency to seek professional help. The incident demonstrates that even those who preach the power of prayer ultimately depend on practical secular solutions when faced with real emergencies.
